mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced capital expenditure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-Fed tightening cycle, a rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% annually compresses real interest rates and increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as post-Fed tightening with CPIAUCSL > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has fallen below 550.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending power and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market slack regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100.0 thousand) signals an economic recovery that boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0 and PAYEMS > 100.0.
